confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live booking pages or current menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Alcohol prices (beer, cocktail, wine) are less certain because bar pricing varies widely by venue and hotel tier. Accommodation anchors assume a July low-season rate with taxes and fees included, and hostel dorm and private-room availability is the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship, with cocktails about 1.5 times beer and wine about 1.4 times beer, because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Gulf and Middle East tourism-hub pattern, using Abu Dhabi and Doha as reference points for restaurant and alcohol pricing. Accommodation is adjusted for a July low-season window, since Dubai hotel rates fall considerably in summer.
